answer: Put identities that vouch for each other into one shared vault: a cluster posts a joint bond, and if any member is proven fake, the whole vault is slashed, so a farmer's clones become each other's liability instead of cover. Then run a mirror check: compare signing keys, device fingerprints and work rhythms of cluster members — clones reflect one operator, and their patterns line up too neatly. Finally release earnings like shale settling: payouts trickle out over weeks, so even a thousand undetected fakes cannot cash out before an audit catches them.
